testcase.name: Scenario: Transfer a custom command by double-clicking list rows: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-customization-source/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:468:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Transfer a custom command by double-clicking list rows ✔> Given the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software ✔ And a part is active in the MCAD Software ✔ And the ribbon customization dialog has an empty Part Tools custom panel ✔ And "2D Sketches" is available in the source list ✔ When the user double-clicks "2D Sketches" in the source list ✔ Then "2D Sketches" moves to the custom panel list ✔ And the target indicates a pending change ✔ When the user double-clicks "2D Sketches" in the custom panel list ✔ Then the custom panel list is empty ✔ And "2D Sketches" is available in the source list again ✔ And the target still indicates a pending change ✔ When the user clicks "Cancel" ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And no User Commands panel appears on the Tools ribbon
